purpose: Source-only publication of the physically demonstrated R106/R111/R115 configuration
changes: Public Vivado build.tcl maps the original selected RTL paths to repository-relative rtl/ and third_party/; DRC Error string explicitly quoted. Original build-board-r2.tcl retained.
Kernel .config clears the original absolute INITRAMFS_SOURCE; user must provide an initramfs.
Actual loaded DT decompiled; fixed historical RNG seed replaced by an incbin generated freshly per boot bundle.
Historical reference recipes replace original workstation paths with documented placeholders and are not the portable build entry.
Portable native video runner adapts the bounded per-command PCH cleanup policy from build_artifact_guard_v2; frozen original project files are unchanged.
No proprietary generated IP, FSBL/BSP, toolchain or operating-system binary image is distributed.
Decompiled DT numeric interrupt/PHY references rewritten as equivalent labels, retaining original explicit phandle values.
Only selected software preparation recipes are published; failed and unrelated historical hardware gate revisions remain in the sealed original snapshot, not this release.
